description: Java source code for the SelfLoansApiResource class, providing REST API endpoints for self-service loan operations in the Fineract platform, including retrieving, updating, and managing loans, transactions, charges, templates, and guarantors.

classes.name: SelfLoansApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for self-service loan operations, including retrieval, updates, and management of loans, transactions, charges, templates, and guarantors.

methods.name: retrieveLoan
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific loan by loanId, validating user mapping.

methods.name: retrieveTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific loan transaction.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanCharges
methods.description: Lists all charges associated with a specific loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific loan charge.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves loan detail templates for UI building, with validation for clientId and templateType.

methods.name: calculateLoanScheduleOrSubmitLoanApplication
methods.description: Calculates repayment schedule or submits a new loan application after validation.

methods.name: modifyLoanApplication
methods.description: Updates a loan application if in the correct state, with validation.

methods.name: stateTransitions
methods.description: Performs state transition commands like withdrawal from loan application.

methods.name: validateAppuserLoanMapping
methods.description: Validates if the current user is mapped to the specified loan.

methods.name: validateAppuserClientsMapping
methods.description: Validates if the current user is mapped to the specified client.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if a command parameter matches a specific value.

methods.name: retrieveGuarantorDetails
methods.description: Retrieves guarantor details for a specific loan.
